question: If the distribution is negatively skewed then
solution:
The correct answer is **Mean **

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• **Mean 
 
• In a negatively skewed distribution, the tail is on the left side of the distribution, meaning the bulk of the data points are concentrated on the right.
 
• The mean is pulled toward the tail, making it less than the mode (which is the highest point of the distribution).
 
• For financial enterprises, this could indicate that a few extremely low values are dragging the average down, which could be important for risk assessment and financial planning.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Mean > Median:**

 
 
• This is incorrect. In a negatively skewed distribution, the mean is less than the median because the mean is influenced by the lower values in the tail.
 
 
 
• **Mean > Mode:**
 
 
• This is also incorrect. Similar to the mean and median, the mean is less than the mode in a negatively skewed distribution.
 
 
 
• **Median > Mode:**
 
 
• While the median is greater than the mean in a negatively skewed distribution, it is not necessarily greater than the mode. The mode is the most frequently occurring value and is generally the highest point in the distribution.
